_note: Verified rules only. Every entry has a source. If something is not here, the agent must say 'not covered - verify' instead of guessing. Last checked: 2026-10-10.

rules.who_to_address: Public Information Officer (PIO) of the public authority that holds the information. Central: CPIO. State: SPIO.
rules.first_appeal: To the First Appellate Authority (an officer senior to the PIO in the same public authority), within 30 days of receiving the reply or of the reply deadline expiring.
rules.second_appeal: To the Information Commission (Central Information Commission for central authorities; State Information Commission for state authorities), within 90 days of the first appeal decision or of the date it was due.
good_practice: Ask for specific records (copies of work orders, inspection reports, budget sanctioned and spent, file notings with dates), not opinions or explanations.
Avoid 'why' questions; PIOs can reject them as not 'information'.
Give a time period for the records requested.

rti_central.name: RTI to Central public authorities (RTI Rules, 2012)

rti_assam.name: RTI to Assam State public authorities (Assam RTI Rules)
rti_assam.offline_payment: Indian Postal Order, demand draft/banker's cheque, or cash against receipt at the office
rti_assam.word_limit_note: No state word limit verified; keep under 500 words as good practice.

cpgrams.name: CPGRAMS (Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System)
cpgrams.appeal: If the grievance is closed and you rate the disposal 'Poor', an appeal option opens; file it within 30 days.
cpgrams.notes: Also accepts grievances for State Governments, which are forwarded to state nodal officers. Choose the correct ministry and subordinate office.

assam_cm_grievance.name: Write to the Chief Minister of Assam (grievance)
assam_cm_grievance.notes: For any Assam Government service, scheme or office. Deadline not verified; do not state one.

gmc_grievance.name: Guwahati Municipal Corporation grievance redressal
gmc_grievance.how: Written complaint on plain paper addressed to the Commissioner or the Public Grievance Officer, GMC, sent by post or email. Helpline/WhatsApp also available.
gmc_grievance.address: Public Grievance Officer, Guwahati Municipal Corporation, Panbazar, Guwahati - 781001

legal_aid.name: Free legal aid
legal_aid.text: For complex or disputed cases, contact your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) for free legal aid.
